title: PH opens campaign in inaugural FIFA U15 World Cup vs. Morocco
summary: The Philippine Under-15 Men's National Football Team will open their campaign in the FIFA U15 World Cup & Festival against Morocco on Saturday at the Hovsan Competition Complex in Baku, Azerbaijan.
